_comment: AUTO-GENERATED by scraper/extract_choice_groups.py from the footnotes on the SU degree pages (degrees/*.html). Do not edit by hand; re-run the extractor (or scraper.build_degree_graphs) to regenerate. Either/or groups within the Required section: a group is satisfied once one of its alternatives is completed, so the unused alternatives are not reported as still-needed. Forms: {"choose": 1, "options": [...]} for symmetric one-of-many, and {"satisfied_by_any_of": [[...], [...]]} for compound rules (complete ALL courses in ANY ONE inner list). Keyed by program; applies to every cohort.
